title: Chapter 585
paragraphs: Chapter 585
Episode 151. Situation Summary (5)
Usually, after pointing a weapon, if you ask, "What are you?", it's customary to wait for an answer.
Bang-!
However, the man was the type who denied the conventional form of threat, immediately firing the loaded cannon.
Moreover, what he was aiming at was not just Jin and Ciris, but the very hut where he had been cooking his meals just moments ago, a hut that had stood firmly in this wilderness for over 30 years.
Jin was more shocked by that fact than being attacked by the cannon, and that the cannon possessed a force far beyond his expectations.
Swoosh!
Before Jin could step forward and deflect the bullet, Ciris reacted first. The ice wall that unfolded from her hand covered the front of the hut, blocking the bullet.
Seeing the powerful explosion hitting the transparent ice wall, Ciris gritted her teeth. Her pupils were instantly soaked in dark anger.
"This damn bastard."
"Um, Ciris? We can't kill him. It seems he is Quaul Ganesto. At least, it's clear he's related. I've never heard of a portable cannon of this level."
Bang, bang! Bang! While Jin was speaking, the cannon continued to spew fire. In just a few seconds, the whole field of vision was about to be covered by black smoke.
"Then, let's just cut off his two arms."
"That line seems to suit Yona more than you, Ciris. Whether to cripple him, kill him, or forgive him. Let's subdue him first and then decide."
Jin threw himself outside the ice wall. As soon as he raised a wind of sword to clear the nearby smoke, Jin had to face an unexpected landscape.
'Have these weapons already been set up?'
Mysterious bluish rods popped out from between the oddly bent trees, and there were objects that looked like gun barrels and cannon barrels in between.
The ground full of weeds had become a flat metal floor. The complex line on the floor gave an intuition that it could be transformed into a trap like fortress defense equipment.
All of these changes occurred before even 10 seconds had passed.
'It's as surprising as when I first met Amela.'
Amela at that time was in a state where the chaos of being tipsy was amplified, but the changes caused by the man were purely the product of magical engineering.
As expected, as soon as I lifted my foot from the metal floor, the trap was activated. The line opened, and sharp hooks sprang out from inside, grabbing my ankles.
Of course, it's an extraordinary engineering feat. Perhaps even a normal martial artist, no. Even a martial artist above 7-star would not have been able to withstand a few of the man's traps.
But the opponents were Jin and Ciris.
The hooks couldn't even scratch Jin's aura armor, and they were futilely bent. Although he couldn't avoid it, he intentionally opened his armor to understand its power.
'The feeling of heaviness in my ankles isn't bad. It would be quite effective if installed in Tikan.'
For Jin who had opened his aura armor, it was a hefty level, but it had a cutting power that could even chop off the ankles of fairly well-trained knights like a piece of cake.
Next, a cannon hit Jin's back. Similarly, Jin was satisfied with the tingling sensation in his back and waist, and he did not avoid the shining net that attacked him next.
'A tough net that is hard to cut even with an 8-star level blow... This could be useful.'
With a chuckle, Jin tore the net with his hand and smiled.
To put it simply, Jin had already decided to recruit the man.
Whether he is Kwa-ul or not, what his character is, what his intentions are. There was no need to worry about such things.
It was because he had the ability. It should never happen that such a person becomes loyal to the enemy. Especially in times like these.
If the man is a human trash, he will be forced to work, if he is a person who can communicate, he will show generosity, and if he is loyal to Ziphil, he will break his heart.
'He should never be in Ziphil.'
And suddenly, if the man can produce such items in large quantities without difficulty.
Then wouldn't the era of knights be nearing its end, such a thought briefly crossed Jin's mind.
The next moment, Jin felt that bitter premonition even more deeply.
'I'm feeling aura concentrating... Something is interfering...!'
It was not serious.
Even if you use the aura as naturally as breathing, if a hundred auras gather, now about ninety-five were concentrated.
But this was only when Jin, a martial artist, was considered as a standard. Because the aura affinity that Jin has far exceeds the general criteria.
For ordinary martial artists, this would be fatal, and even Jin, assuming he was dealing with a superhuman person, it was a dangerous phenomenon.

Sirius also seemed to have felt the same sensation, his expression hardening. As a martial artist, it was something that was bound to be shocking, even if it wouldn't cause a problem in suppressing the man.
He quickly rolled his eyes to find the factor suspected to be the cause.
The rods protruding through the trees, they were the cause. A strange aura emanating from the rod was interfering with the flow of aura.
The rod only affected the aura. The magic and aura that were spread out for a test were not hindered in their flow at all.
For a moment, goosebumps rose on his back and waist.
If the man is Kwa-ul Ganesto, the reason for making that rod artifact is to deal with RunKandel more easily on behalf of Ziphil. Just like the mass production blueprint and the teleportation device.
The verification of the man's magic engineering artifacts was over.
Jin exploded the aura in one breath and repelled the traps and bullets that were trying to bind him.
As he took a step forward in a rush, the ground where Jin was standing exploded, and fragments flew about. It wasn't the trap that exploded, but rather it was caused by Jin's immense strength.
The brilliant energy that burst from Siegmund showed a gruesome sight as it clashed with the man's artifacts.
Most of the artifacts were either rendered useless or destroyed in an instant, but the rod, indeed, seemed to be of another level among his works and it resiliently held on.
Jin never intended to break the rod in the first place. Damaging such a valuable item would be foolish.
"Tingen Bower."
Before Tingen could blink, he felt Jin's voice, which was visible in front of him, echoing from behind him.
Naturally, as a person capable of fortifying the entire space in an instant, the man had a plethora of defensive artifacts protecting him.
But while his figure was visible in front, the voice came from behind, and even before the sentence finished, a piercing attack came from the left side of the dark man.
And as soon as the shield on the left side broke, the same thing happened on the right side.
The energy, spreading like light, was suddenly pounding on all sides of him.
"What are you! How did you know and find this place?"
As soon as the man admitted that he was Tingen, Jin smirked inwardly once again.
The feeling that things were going too well to be comfortable was now long gone. He felt like he had hit the jackpot and couldn't afford to let it slip away.
"A kind of headhunter?"
As all the shields exploded simultaneously, Tingen's body was knocked back.
Normally, the human inside the shield would also be impacted by such a shock.
'Don't kill him, he said, but he's handling the guy more aggressively... Wait, did he only destroy the shields perfectly?'
But Jin's attacks amazingly destroyed only the shields, and Tingen's body was lifted due to the air pressure.
Jin caught Tingen softly before he could crash onto the hard metal floor.
Cyrus clicked his tongue inwardly as he watched this, feeling the gap between them once more.
'Jin Lundel seems far away every time I meet him...'
Cyrus no longer felt any bitterness that Jin's achievements were much faster than his own.
He sincerely admired Jin, and more than anything, he knew the path Jin had taken to gain such power, although he still felt somewhat bitter for some unknown reason.
"You can't afford to hurt yourself, Tingen Bower. Or rather, Quale Ganesto."
This time, goosebumps appeared on Tingen's nape.
As far as Tingen knew, there was not a single person in the world who knew that name, apart from himself. Even the leaders of Zipfel, where he had worked until recently, didn't know it.
"What... did you just say?"
"The descendant of the ancient Lundel Knight, Rokia Ganesto, Quale Ganesto. Judging by your reaction, it's definitely you."
"Phew-!"
A flash of light burst from Quaul's hand. It was an artifact similar in form to Chenmi's flash cannon, used to obscure the opponent's vision.
Jin raised a handful of spiritual energy and completely swallowed the light of the artifact. It's been a long time since he had surpassed the level where such tricks could affect him.
"I am Jin Runekandel, the 12th successor of the current Runekandel and the legitimate heir of the ancient Runekandel."
"What are you blabbering about all of a sudden? What do you want?"
"So, I wanted to ask. Why is the descendant of the Ten Knights working for Zipple?"
Even in front of the overwhelming power that rendered his artifacts useless, there was no fear on Tingjen's face.
However, he was filled with surprise at the fact that Jin knew his real name.
"It doesn't seem like I need to answer that."
"Even after a thousand years, a Knight of the Ten is still a Knight of the Ten, and their descendants are the same. Just by working for Zipple, you've already committed a great sin."
He didn't truly believe that.
Honestly, after a thousand years, if the family that was supposed to be loyal couldn't protect or even remember them, then betrayal for survival was inevitable.
"Do you think that makes sense? Even a passing dog or a mountainous plant would laugh at that."

"Even without bringing up the affairs of a thousand years ago, you've made many contributions to Zipple. That alone is more than enough reason for you to meet death by the sword of Runekandel. However, as I said, I am a headhunter. Whether that means recruitment or literally cutting off heads depends on your choice."
"Well, then I refuse. Kill me, if you can."
"You're giving up too easily."
"You should have felt it when you attacked me. How many techniques can you learn from me? How tempting am I? You can never kill me. What did you say earlier, that you can't hurt a valuable body?"

"That's right. So I'm thinking about how we can work together more harmoniously. Forced labor is always painful, isn't it? Judging by the way you live, it seems like there's something wrong with Zipple too. A good thing is a good thing, as the saying goes."
"You want to talk with me?"
Jin nodded his head.
"I'm different from you, who started by shooting magic cannons indiscriminately."
"Let me have a smoke and then we'll talk again."
"Take your time."
After lighting up five cigarettes in a row, Tingjen finally said this.
"If you answer a few questions and meet the conditions I propose, I'll consider leaving this shabby place."
